evals.expected_output: Umple with public static void main, new Person(...), compiles.
expectations: The Umple source contains 'public static void main'
The main body is tagged with Java
The main constructs a Person with a name argument
The API was called with language=Java
String [ ] args or String[] args appears in the main signature
A model.ump (or equivalent) was saved or shown

evals.expected_output: Main calls off() and on() (or equivalent event methods).
expectations: The Umple source contains a main method
The main invokes the off event and the on event
The Light state machine is preserved

evals.expected_output: Main constructs Member and Book and calls an add* association method.
expectations: The Umple source contains public static void main
new Member and new Book (or equivalent) appear in main

expectations: There is a Java-tagged main body
There is a Python-tagged main body

class Person does not contain main

evals.expected_output: Constructor gets id and name; no setId call.
expectations: Person uses immutable id (or equivalent)
main uses new Person with id and name
main does not call setId

main fires open and close events

evals.prompt: Add a main. If the first compile fails, fix it (max 3 retries).
evals.expected_output: Agent compiles, retries at most 3 times on failure, then stops if still failing.
expectations: The API was called at least once
On compile failure the agent attempts a fix or stops with the message
The agent does not retry more than 3 times after failures
Final Umple is shown to the user

expectations: public static void main is present
new Counter appears (with or without args depending on generated ctor)
Something is printed or the object is used
